```python
# tests/test_parse_csv_line.py

import pytest

from your_module import parse_csv_line


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    ("line", "expected"),
    [
        ("a,b,c", ["a", "b", "c"]),
        ("one,two,three", ["one", "two", "three"]),
        ('"a,b",c', ["a,b", "c"]),
        ('a,"b,c",d', ["a", "b,c", "d"]),
        ('"a","b","c"', ["a", "b", "c"]),
        ('name,"Doe, Jane",42', ["name", "Doe, Jane", "42"]),
        ('café,東京,"x,y"', ["café", "東京", "x,y"]),
    ],
)
def test_parse_csv_line_happy_paths(line: str, expected: list[str]) -> None:
    assert parse_csv_line(line) == expected


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    ("line", "expected"),
    [
        ("", [""]),
        (",", ["", ""]),
        (",,", ["", "", ""]),
        ("a,,c", ["a", "", "c"]),
        (",a,b", ["", "a", "b"]),
        ("a,b,", ["a", "b", ""]),
        ('""', [""]),
        ('a,"",c', ["a", "", "c"]),
        ("  a  ,  b  ", ["  a  ", "  b  "]),
        ('" spaced value "', [" spaced value "]),
        ('a,"b\nc",d', ["a", "b\nc", "d"]),
    ],
)
def test_parse_csv_line_edge_cases(line: str, expected: list[str]) -> None:
    assert parse_csv_line(line) == expected


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    ("line", "expected"),
    [
        ('"unterminated', ["unterminated"]),
        ('a,"b,c', ["a", "b,c"]),
        ('a"b,c', ["ab,c"]),
        ('a,"b"c,d', ["a", "bc", "d"]),
        ('a,"b""c",d', ["a", "bc", "d"]),
    ],
)
def test_parse_csv_line_unusual_quotes_document_current_behavior(
    line: str,
    expected: list[str],
) -> None:
    # The current implementation toggles quote state on every double quote
    # and does not validate unbalanced/malformed quotes.
    assert parse_csv_line(line) == expected


@pytest.mark.parametrize("bad_line", [None, 123, 12.3, b"a,b,c"])
def test_parse_csv_line_invalid_input_types_raise_type_error(bad_line: object) -> None:
    with pytest.raises(TypeError):
        parse_csv_line(bad_line)  # type: ignore[arg-type]
```

Note: malformed quote cases currently do **not** raise errors because the function has no quote-balance validation.
